title: What Is GDP and How Does India Calculate It? The New 2022-23 Series Explained
seoTitle: What is GDP and how India calculates it (2026 series)
seoDescription: GDP is the value of all goods and services made in India. How MoSPI calculates it, GDP vs GVA, why figures get revised and what the 2022-23 base changed.
excerpt: GDP vs GVA, the three methods, MoSPI's release cycle from advance to final estimates, why a quarter's GDP fell from ₹86 to ₹80 lakh crore on paper, and the deflator debate.
